purpose: Prespecified scientific revision responding to the independent manuscript review
primary_clock: Per-policy conservative budgets from isolated single-host profiling, frozen before evaluation; clock budgets are independent of worker scheduling
measured_confirmation: Serial runs on the first two evaluation synthetic graphs at each of 24,36,48 nodes; first three held-out seeds; qsp,fast_sequential,fast_joint,aware
budget_rule: Use training-host p95 selection call durations plus a common 0.02 ms dispatch allowance; full-search budget is at least the base budget
controller_rule: Calibrate quantum-only headroom; skip broader search when its optimistic improvement cannot exceed observed offer rate times incremental profiled compute cost times fallback success. Charge expected compute time inside deadline tests and realized or profiled selection time in execution. Any completed full search pays full cost even on fallback.
forecast_rule: Serialize outcome packets together against shared frozen residual-work floors. Background arrivals, other-request control packets and loss remain approximations, not exact concurrent forecasts.
calibration_rule: Train-only monotone probability curves with 8 pseudo-observations per global bin and 32 per feature cell; features are coarse offered load, memory scale and number of outcomes. Online residual correction uses completed requests only, EMA weight 0.03, clipped to [-0.30,0.30]. No outage schedule, risk-group identity or future offers are exposed to the selector.
estimand: Qualified fraction of all post-burn-in offers, equal weight per topology; report each workload and ordinary workloads pooled separately from outage
uncertainty: 10000 topology-bootstrap draws; paired seeds and offered tapes. No treating request records as independent environments.
success_criterion: A superiority claim requires positive paired lower 95% bounds against BOTH qsp and fast_sequential in the prespecified ordinary-workload aggregate. If unmet, report it without retuning evaluation rules or selecting a favorable aggregate.
resource_reporting: Common 3000-byte-hop planned cap and identical per-node slots. Report realized traffic and slot-ms explicitly; a shared cap is not an exact equality of consumed resources.
tracking_scope: QNP-inspired bidirectional TRACK forwarding with local asynchronous swaps, shared generation and activation, destination-frame completion as the common metric, and both directional routes budgeted. It does not reproduce full QNP virtual-circuit setup, demultiplexing, test rounds or recovery.
priority_scope: Finite 16-packet nonpreemptive strict control-over-background priority, FIFO within class, no eviction, same physical links and traffic cap. This changes the classical service discipline and is labeled separately.
self_contention_probe: 14 evaluation graphs x 3 offered loads x 12 frozen-emission cases. Replay outcomes jointly and individually against identical fresh background tapes; isolate within-request outcome interaction with quantum emission times fixed. No adaptive routing or activation change in the probe.
